body.cap: FarmPro has announced the development of a SaaS solution named ‘FarmPlusCare,’ combining IoT, big data, AI, and machine learning to help livestock farms reduce the risks of animal diseases and mortality. │Photo provided by FarmPro

body.x: FarmPro participated in CES 2024 in Las Vegas, USA, from January 9th (Tuesday) to 12th (Friday, local time).

FarmPro has developed a SaaS solution named ‘FarmPlusCare,’ combining IoT, big data, AI, and machine learning to help livestock farms reduce the risks of animal diseases and mortality. Additionally, ‘FarmKing’ is a smart artificial insemination device that replaces traditional methods.

Founded on CEO Park Byung-ok’s over ten years of experience operating livestock farms, FarmPro aimed to address the challenges of infectious diseases and repeated breeding and death cycles in densely populated spaces. The development of ‘FarmPlusCare’ stemmed from the desire to monitor the health of livestock, prevent fatal infectious diseases in advance, and achieve minimal animal welfare.

FarmPlusCare monitors the health status of livestock in real-time, preventing diseases and enhancing productivity. Using IoT ear tag devices attached to the animals, data is collected every 10 minutes. The big data analysis algorithm predicts health, estrus, and calving times, providing timely notifications to farmers through a dedicated web platform and mobile application. FarmPlusCare reduces livestock mortality rates, increases farm productivity, and prevents unnecessary deaths by predicting diseases early, reducing greenhouse gas emissions and antibiotic usage. Notably, FarmPlusCare is highlighted as the only device that allows real-time observation of the health status of newborn livestock immediately after birth.

An official stated, “FarmPlusCare can measure the body temperature of livestock with an accuracy of 0.1°C, with a deviation of only 0.5 degrees. It can simultaneously measure real-time movement and body temperature, making it practical and user-friendly, even for beginners. In addition, it possesses a high market competitiveness with a reasonable price.”

body.cap: Smart Artificial Insemination Device ‘FarmKing’ │Photo provided by FarmPro

body.x: Furthermore, ‘FarmKing’ is described as a safe and fast artificial insemination device, enabling convenient and hygienic artificial insemination. Its built-in temperature sensor and camera can anticipate disease symptoms, allowing remote monitoring with veterinarians through online networks. It is also praised for its high pregnancy rate, enabling real-time tracking and artificial insemination without needing experts.

body.x: The official expressed, “Through participating in CES 2024, we aim to enhance awareness of FarmPro and our products (FarmPlusCare, FarmKing), meet potential buyers or partners, and explore business opportunities.”
